up: For the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1142268, list all associated compounds. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Order the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1142268'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
